title: plectranthus parviflorus var. australis
intro: Plectranthus parviflorus var. australis, commonly known as Australian Spotted-Feverfew, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, headache, and inflammation, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Plectranthus parviflorus var. australis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
